# Change summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why it is needed.

## Compatibility and provenance

- [ ] Existing API, integration and plugin behavior is preserved or the change is documented.
- [ ] Data migration and rollback effects are documented where applicable.
- [ ] New source and assets have recorded provenance and compatible licenses.
- [ ] No private data, credentials or generated secrets are committed.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests were added or updated.
- [ ] Relevant existing tests pass.
- [ ] UI changes were inspected at the intended viewport and keyboard flow.
- [ ] Build and test intermediates were cleaned without removing required evidence.
